get.description: Retrieve CRM object tags for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access tags associated with a particular object type, which can be useful for categorizing and managing CRM data effectively.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which to retrieve tags.

post.description: Create a new CRM object tag for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define properties such as name, color, and filter criteria for the tag. It is useful for categorizing and organizing CRM objects based on custom criteria.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the tag is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve a specific CRM object tag using its unique identifiers. This endpoint is useful for obtaining details about a particular tag associated with a CRM object type, which can help in managing or analyzing tagged data within your HubSpot account.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the CRM object type to which the tag belongs.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag to retrieve.

put.description: Update an existing CRM object tag in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the properties of a tag identified by its objectTypeId and tagId. Use this endpoint to change tag details such as name, color, and associated filters.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type to which the tag belongs.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag to be updated.

delete.description: Delete a specific CRM object tag identified by its object type ID and tag ID. This operation will remove the tag from the system, and it will no longer be available for use or reference.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type to which the tag belongs.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag to be deleted.
